environment.networking: userspace, no host networking, no privileged mode, no host Podman socket

result: PASS (author-run authenticated tailnet HTTPS and restricted-boundary evidence; mobile-data UAT, independent acceptance and deployment are not tested)

checks.name: deterministic control-route denial
checks.detail: Core test proves Office assets and the explicit Office allowlist register, while Worker, Supervisor, reviewer, verifier, Quality Gate control and unknown routes return 404 with and without role credentials

checks.name: Compose policy and negative policy tests
checks.detail: base and Tailscale overlay policy checks pass; 19 policy tests cover image pinning, capabilities, devices, host ports, networks, Serve config, Funnel and origin binding

checks.name: real rootless Podman overlay
checks.detail: pinned Tailscale container started with userspace networking, read-only root, all capabilities dropped, no host port and only the two dedicated networks; Core retained its loopback-only publication

checks.name: tailnet identity persistence
checks.detail: the enrolled node and Serve configuration survived a forced container recreation with the persistent state volume; the node remained the same tailnet identity

checks.name: authenticated tailnet HTTPS
checks.detail: Office HTML, health, setup status and auth session returned 200 over the enrolled HTTPS origin with normal TLS verification; the request traversed the real Tailscale userspace path from a separate test container through a temporary test-only SOCKS listener that is not present in the committed overlay

checks.name: restricted boundary over HTTPS
checks.detail: /worker, /supervisor, /review, /quality/receipts, /quality/pending, /provider/turn_reservations and /actions/{id}/classify returned 404 under both /core-api-prefixed and root URL forms, including encoded, duplicate-slash and dot-segment variants

checks.name: Host and Origin validation
checks.detail: forged Host returned 400; untrusted Origin returned 403; missing Origin on a state-changing request returned 403; the same checks were repeated directly against the restricted Core listener on the private network

checks.name: Secure session cookies over Serve
checks.detail: HTTPS bootstrap returned HttpOnly SameSite=Strict Path=/ Secure session and SameSite=Strict Secure CSRF cookies; authenticated Office projections returned 200 and an unauthenticated project request returned 401

checks.name: CSRF and logout over Serve
checks.detail: missing and wrong CSRF returned 403; a correct CSRF logout returned 204; the revoked cookie returned 401 for a protected route

checks.name: tailnet identity is not Factory authorization
checks.detail: a tailnet-connected request without a Factory session returned 401; the Tailscale identity itself grants no operator authority

not_tested: mobile-data access from the owner's phone (USER_PENDING)
security_notes: The committed Tailscale overlay does not enable a SOCKS proxy; the proxy was a temporary test-only listener used to originate the HTTPS check from a separate container.
No reusable Tailscale auth key, session cookie, bootstrap code or Core credential is recorded in this evidence.
The node has network access only to Core's restricted Office listener; Factory sessions remain the authorization authority.
